Job Title: Data Partnerships Lead

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

We are looking for a Data Partnerships Lead to build and scale our Data Partnerships team, helping companies unlock new revenue opportunities by contributing operational workflow data for AI training and evaluation.

You will define the strategy for sourcing and acquiring partnership opportunities, lead relationships with our most strategic partners, and build the team, processes, and playbooks that enable the function to scale.

What You'll Do

  1. Define and execute the overall strategy for acquiring and growing Data Partnerships.
  2. Build, hire, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of Data Partnerships Managers.
  3. Establish pipeline generation strategies, outbound motions, and partnership playbooks that can scale across industries.
  4. Personally lead relationships with high-value partner companies and executive stakeholders.
  5. Coach the team on discovery, qualification, negotiation, and consultative partnership development.
  6. Develop repeatable frameworks for evaluating partnership opportunities and prioritizing the highest-impact companies.
  7. Partner with Product, Operations, Legal, and Data teams to improve onboarding and partner experience.
  8. Build reporting, forecasting, and performance metrics to continuously improve acquisition efforts.
  9. Help shape pricing, partnership structures, commercial strategy, and market positioning.
  10. Foster a culture of execution, customer obsession, and continuous improvement within the team.

What We're Looking For

  1. Proven experience leading Business Development, Partnerships, or Enterprise Sales teams in high-growth environments.
  2. Track record of building repeatable partnership or commercial acquisition programs from the ground up.
  3. Demonstrated success hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing customer-facing teams.
  4. Strong executive presence with the ability to build trusted relationships with founders, operators, and senior business leaders.
  5. Exceptional commercial judgment and negotiation skills.
  6. Strong understanding of consultative sales methodologies and complex partnership cycles.
  7. Comfortable discussing AI, data privacy, security, confidentiality, and data ownership with executive stakeholders.
  8. Highly entrepreneurial with a bias toward execution and a willingness to build systems from scratch.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Experience leading Strategic Partnerships or Business Development organizations in AI, SaaS, data, marketplaces, or technology companies.
  2. Experience in Venture Capital, particularly in investment or platform roles with a strong network across startup ecosystems.
  3. Experience in Private Equity portfolio operations, value creation, or similar roles supporting operational initiatives across portfolio companies.
  4. Familiarity with data licensing, data acquisition, or emerging AI infrastructure markets.

Compensation & Benefits Notice

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $130,000 –$180,000. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

micro1 is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, reach out to .

Our hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.

Disclaimer

The information contained in this job posting, including but not limited to role responsibilities, qualifications, compensation, and benefits, is provided for informational purposes only and does not constitute a binding offer of employment. micro1 reserves the right to amend, modify, or withdraw any portion of this posting at its sole discretion and without prior notice. All employment decisions are made in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

  2. Apply expert judgment to assess the correctness and consistency of reported estimates, confidence intervals, p-values, analysis populations, and missing data handling in alignment with the statistical analysis plan (SAP).

  6. Collaborate with a multidisciplinary project team, providing statistical insights and feedback as needed to refine evaluation tasks and criteria.

  2. Hands-on experience producing or quality controlling TFLs for regulatory submissions and working directly from CDISC SDTM/ADaM datasets.
  3. Solid understanding of statistical methods used in confirmatory trials, including survival analysis, mixed models, covariate adjustment, multiplicity control, and estimand and missing-data strategies under ICH E9(R1).
  4. Proficiency in SAS and/or R, with the ability to independently reproduce analyses from written specifications.
  5. Ability to interpret SAPs and ensure reported results are consistent with pre-specified analyses.
  6. Advanced degree (MSc or PhD) in Biostatistics, Statistics, or a closely related quantitative field.

  1. Significant experience in robotics research, embodied AI, robot learning, or robotics software engineering.

Role Title: Physics Expert (Postdoc / Junior professor)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (US, Canada, UK focused)

micro1 is engaging Physics Experts (Postdoc / Junior professor) to participate in a high-impact project supporting a customer in the science and technology sector. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Critically evaluate and review physics solutions, mathematical derivations, and theoretical arguments generated by researchers or AI platforms.
  2. Detect errors, unjustified steps, missing assumptions, dimensional inconsistencies, and weaknesses in logic or methodology.
  3. Delineate between substantive scientific issues and stylistic or cosmetic matters, providing technically precise written feedback.
  4. Articulate and document the reasoning behind any identified flaws, ensuring actionable guidance for improvement.
  5. Recognize when correct reasoning can be optimized, and offer suggestions to sharpen or clarify the argument.
  6. Utilize LaTeX, SymPy, Python, and Jupyter to independently verify or counter-check scientific claims as appropriate.
  7. Deliver structured feedback designed to support iterative enhancement of submitted work and project outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. PhD in physics and an active record of independent research within a specialized subfield (e.g., High Energy/Mathematical Physics, Biophysics/Statistical Physics, Condensed Matter, AMO/Quantum Optics, Gravitation/Cosmology, Quantum Information, or Optical Materials).
  2. Experience as a postdoctoral researcher, research fellow, junior/assistant professor, or senior research scientist.
  3. Recent (last ~5 years) representative publications in the relevant subfield, with arXiv or DOI links.
  4. Advanced proficiency with LaTeX, SymPy, Python, and Jupyter for theoretical modeling and computational validation.
  5. Demonstrated skill in reviewing the work of others—through peer review, supervision, dissertation committees, or group seminars.
  6. Exceptional written communication skills with the ability to convey nuanced, constructive feedback with technical rigor.
  7. Reliable access to high-speed internet and a computer suitable for rigorous technical work.

We’re hiring a Member of Technical Staff (MTS) to act as a technical owner operating at the intersection of research, data, and real-world AI systems. This is a hands-on role focused on improving model and system performance through rigorous evaluation, failure analysis, and iterative development.

raw.description:
Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together
Our Meaningful Mission
At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech.Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognizes and supports global connections.

Who You'll Be Joining
We look for mission-driven builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners, always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners, treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.

Our Core Commitments — What We Live By
Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:
  • Integrity:We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
  • Outcomes: We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
  • Velocity:We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

Perks of Joining Our Team
We believe in empowering colleagues because we genuinely trust our team. Our culture is founded on this high trust, which naturally encourages the high ownership that drives us to meet our shared high expectations and deliver high performance. Our remote-first culture means you have the flexibility to work in your employing country wherever you feel the most focused and productive. This freedom comes with wonderful tailored, location-specific perks designed to support your whole life, not just your work. Think unlimited annual leave , great healthcare benefits, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact! In turn, we expect you to bring high ownership and commitment to your work. This is a place where we value trust and high performance, and we'll provide the environment and support needed for you to excel

About the Role
At Zepz, payment operations aren't just a back-office function - they are the critical engine that powers our global cross-border network across WorldRemit and Sendwave. As the Payment Operations Director you will be a hands-on leader who stays deeply in the detail, not above it. Sitting at the intersection of Finance, Engineering, Product, and external payout partners, you will serve as the senior operational owner of all payment functions. By driving down transaction costs and optimising routing velocity, you will directly influence company margins and enable the product team to launch more competitive corridor pricing globally. Your mission is to build an operationally rigorous ecosystem that ensures millions of multi-currency transactions flow seamlessly, automates manual workflows, reduces financial exposure, and optimises transaction execution across sixty continents.

What you bring to the table
Deep payment operations & rail expertise: Extensive, hands-on leadership
experience running high-volume payment operations inside a global FinTech, FX, or
cross-border remittance environment.
Operational decisiveness: You are a proactive problem solver who makes calls quickly
with the information available, driving resolutions without waiting for perfect
conditions or full consensus.
Data-driven accountability: Strong capability to translate operational data into a
clear point of view for senior leadership, using metrics to hold both internal
cross-functional teams and external stakeholders accountable.

What you will focus on
Payment rails & corridor operations: Drive end-to-end transaction execution across
all global payment corridors, ensuring the reliable, accurate, and timely delivery of
funds across bank transfers, card networks, mobile wallets, and cash payout networks.
Decisive route & partner management: Own corridor-level performance metrics
(success rates, payout speed, cost).Transaction monitoring & exception handling:
Build and continuously improve real-time monitoring of transaction flows to detect
issues early. Refine escalation paths and playbooks to resolve transaction exceptions
immediately before they impact customers, treating time-to-resolution as a core
metric.
Process excellence & automation strategy: Design, document, and continuously
improve the core operational processes that underpin payment execution, ledger
matching, and reconciliation. Partner with Engineering and Product to drive the
automation of manual workflows and treat SOPs/runbooks as live operational tools.
Hands-on team leadership: Build, manage, and scale a high-performing team of
payment operations specialists, analysts, and team leads. Set clear goals, conduct
regular performance reviews, and foster a team culture grounded in extreme
ownership, operational rigor, and direct accountability.
Reporting & strategic leadership: Define and own the entire KPI framework for
Payment Operations (including exception volumes, processing times, transaction
success rates, and partner SLA performance). Translate complex operational data into
clear, proactive recommendations and act as a decisive escalation point for complex
operational incidents

Bonus Points if you have
Prior experience using Claude (Anthropic) to accelerate operational analysis, draft training frameworks, or audit internal process documentation.
Experience implementing heavy-duty enterprise reconciliation tools (e.g., ReconArt, Gresham, Fiserv/Frontier, or similar modular matching platforms).
Deep structural knowledge of local clearing systems across emerging markets, particularly APAC, LATAM, and Africa.

AI Literacy & Tools
As Zepz continues to build AI into how we work, we expect everyone to engage with it as a core part of their role. For this position we are looking for:
  • A genuine curiosity about AI and how it can be applied in your area of work — from accelerating analysis and insight generation, to improving how we design and deliver processes and communications.
  • Practical experience using AI tools in a professional context — whether to connect information, draft content, build frameworks, or create insights from data. We want people who actively use AI to increase productivity, not those who are waiting to be told to.
  • Strong AI literacy — an understanding of what AI assistants can and cannot do, how to prompt effectively, and how to critically evaluate AI-generated output before using it.
  • Awareness of the ethical considerations and responsible use of AI in the workplace, particularly in the context of sensitive data, customer experience, and compliance.
  • Prior experience using Claude (Anthropic) is a nice-to-have but not essential — what matters most is that you are genuinely engaged with AI as a tool, comfortable experimenting, and eager to share what works with your wider team

If you want to join us in our journey to help break barriers in financial access and improve lives globally, there's no better place or time to join.

Our global team of 800+ people is spread across six continents.We aspire to hire the best mix of people from former Olympians to YouTube influencers and we speak over twenty languages. This incredible diversity isn't a bonus; it's the engine that lets us serve the world.

Ready to Apply? Let’s Go.

As the Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer, you will lead the design and development of next-generation patient care products - from concept through production - translating caregiver feedback, customer reviews, and competitive insights into profitable, manufacturable solutions with exceptional ergonomics, usability, and functional detail.

This is a full-time, remote independent contractor position.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to enhancing the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a passionate, diverse team from around the globe, the company prides itself on creating products that are not only well-designed but genuinely useful. Customer obsession is a guiding principle that shapes the company's strategy, culture, and decisions.

The company's mission is centered on improving well-being through meticulous attention to detail and continuous listening to customer feedback, ensuring that its solutions meet real caregiving needs. Its vision is to empower patients and caregivers with innovative products that improve quality of life. The company also values caring customer service, professional growth, work-life balance, and a supportive environment where team members can thrive and contribute to meaningful product impact.

This is a Full-Time | Fully Remote position reporting to the Project Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end design process from concept development to production-ready solutions, ensuring all designs go through rigorous DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and DFA (Design for Assembly) analysis.
  • Translate internal product briefs, caregiver feedback, VOC data, and customer reviews into innovative, user-centered product concepts.
  • Apply deep materials knowledge to select the most suitable materials that balance aesthetic with structural durability and cost-efficiency.
  • Create advanced CAD models and detailed technical design and engineering documentation, utilizing FEA (Finite Element Analysis) and structural simulations to validate mechanical integrity and performance before prototyping.
  • Design and validate mockups, prototypes, and functional test samples.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, sourcing partners, and marketing to balance creativity with cost targets, supplier capabilities, and timelines.
  • Optimize design-to-prototype cycle times and improve design efficiency.
  • Maintain high standards of manufacturability, functional performance, and customer satisfaction (targeting 4.5+ product ratings).
  • Communicate effectively with international manufacturing partners, including Asian/China suppliers.

Expected Outcomes:

  • Deliver 4–6 fully engineered, manufacturable product designs within the first 3 months.
  • Develop final production-ready samples of 12–18 new SKUs by the end of 2026.
  • Achieve 30% contribution margin in design cost modeling.
  • Optimize and meet quarterly design-to-prototype cycle time targets within the first 6 months.
  • Implement a structured, user-driven design process for top legacy products within 12 months.
  • Establish and maintain a repeatable, scalable design documentation system.

Qualifications:

    • 3+ years of experience in Industrial Design or Product Design.
    • 2+ years designing mass-produced consumer, HME, or DME (patient care) products.
    • Experience taking products from concept to mass production.
    • Experience in mechanical design, prototyping, simulation, and testing.
    • Experience working within manufacturing and supplier constraints.
    • Experience communicating and collaborating with Asian/Chinese manufacturers.
    • Experience designing products for marketplaces influenced by public customer reviews.
    • Experience with mechanical CAD software, such as SolidWorks, Inventor, Onshape.
    • Experience with cost modeling and margin-focused design decisions.
    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable design improvements.
    • Deep understanding of ergonomics, usability, and user-centered design principles.
    • Close attention to detail and commitment to excellence.
    • Proactive problem-solver with a strong ownership mindset.
    • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.
    • High adaptability and ability to thrive in a fast-scaling environment.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to Detail – Nothing slips through the cracks.
  • Commitment & Work Ethic – Willingness to go the distance to get results.
  • Consistency & Persistence – Demonstrates tenacity in achieving goals.
  • Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset – Sees and communicates the bigger picture.
  • Proactive Problem Solving – Brings new ideas without being prompted.
  • Integrity & Trustworthiness – Operates with honesty and transparency.
  • Customer Obsession – Actively integrates customer feedback into product improvements.
  • Creativity & Innovation – Develops original, differentiated solutions.
  • High Standards – Expects excellence from self and team.
  • Teamwork & Cross-Functional Collaboration – Works seamlessly across departments.
  • Analytical Thinking – Transforms data into informed design decisions.
  • Flexibility & Adaptability – Thrives in dynamic and evolving conditions.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Opportunity to design next-generation patient care products with meaningful market impact.
  • Direct influence on revenue growth and product innovation strategy.
  • High ownership and autonomy in decision-making.
  • A performance-driven, values-based culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored Company Trips.
  • Quarterly Rock Bonus.
  • Performance Bonus.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is a unique opportunity for a senior-level designer who combines creativity with engineering discipline, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer empathy with commercial awareness.

Job Title: Product Security Engineer

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

We are seeking a Product Security Engineer to help define the future of AI-native security engineering. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of application security, machine learning, and developer productivity—designing autonomous security systems that scale with modern software development.

You will lead the evolution of our security platform by embedding AI-driven controls directly into the software lifecycle, enabling continuous risk discovery, intelligent remediation, and secure deployment at the speed of innovation.

What You'll Do

  1. Architect and build AI-powered security systems that autonomously identify, triage, and remediate vulnerabilities across applications, infrastructure, and AI workloads.
  2. Develop agentic security workflows that leverage LLMs and machine learning for code review, threat detection, vulnerability correlation, root-cause analysis, and automated fix generation.
  3. Reimagine the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) by integrating intelligent security controls, AI guardrails, and continuous validation into CI/CD pipelines.
  4. Lead threat modeling initiatives for distributed systems, AI platforms, RAG architectures, model-serving infrastructure, data pipelines, and autonomous agents.
  5. Design security frameworks for protecting AI systems against emerging threats including prompt injection, model abuse, data poisoning, adversarial attacks, and sensitive data leakage.
  6. Build behavioral detection models and risk engines to identify synthetic identities, document fraud, account takeover attempts, and other adversarial activity within customer onboarding and KYC workflows.
  7. Apply machine learning and contextual risk scoring to reduce alert fatigue, prioritize security findings, and drive autonomous remediation decisions.
  8. Partner closely with engineering, platform, and AI research teams to ensure security is embedded as a native capability rather than a downstream function.
  9. Scale a culture of security engineering through mentorship, technical leadership, and enablement programs focused on secure AI development practices.

What We're Looking For

  1. Demonstrated experience building or applying AI/LLM-powered security solutions, including agentic workflows, autonomous remediation systems, vulnerability discovery, or security copilots.
  2. Deep expertise in Application Security, Product Security, or Security Engineering with a strong software development background.
  3. Hands-on experience integrating enterprise security tooling (e.g., Snyk, Checkmarx, GitHub Advanced Security, Semgrep, Wiz, Lacework) into automated developer workflows and AI-driven orchestration platforms.
  4. Strong understanding of modern security architecture, cloud-native systems, APIs, microservices, and distributed computing environments.
  5. Deep familiarity with OWASP Top 10, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, secure AI development practices, and emerging AI threat models.
  6. Advanced programming skills in Python and at least one additional language such as Go, Java, Rust, or Node.js.
  7. 8+ years of experience spanning Application Security, Software Engineering, Infrastructure Security, or related technical domains.
  8. Proven track record driving large-scale automation initiatives and transforming security programs from reactive operations to autonomous, intelligence-driven systems.
  9. Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical and AI-related risks into strategic business decisions.

Preferred

  1. Experience securing AI products, foundation model platforms, inference infrastructure, or agentic systems in production environments.
  2. Background in applied machine learning, security data science, fraud detection, or behavioral analytics.
  3. Contributions to open-source security tools, AI security research, or industry thought leadership.
  4. Experience operating within high-growth technology companies, AI labs, or research-driven engineering organizations.
  5. Familiarity with emerging areas such as AI red teaming, model evaluation, agent security, autonomous penetration testing, or AI safety engineering.

raw.description:
Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together
Our Meaningful Mission
At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech.Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognizes and supports global connections.

Who You'll Be Joining
We look for mission-driven builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners, always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners, treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.Our Core

Commitments — What We Live By
Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:
  • Integrity:We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
  • Outcomes:We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
  • Velocity:We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

Perks of Joining Our Team
We believe in empowering colleagues because we genuinely trust our team. Our culture is founded on this high trust, which naturally encourages the high ownership that drives us to meet our shared high expectations and deliver high performance. Our remote-first culture means you have the flexibility to work in your employing country wherever you feel the most focused and productive. This freedom comes with wonderful tailored, location-specific perks designed to support your whole life, not just your work. Think unlimited annual leave , great healthcare benefits, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact! In turn, we expect you to bring high ownership and commitment to your work. This is a place where we value trust and high performance, and we'll provide the environment and support needed for you to excel

About the role
Your ultimate mission is to own the end-to-end stablecoin wallet experience, from the moment a customer funds their wallet to the moment they cash out, and to keep pushing what the wallet can do next. You will own the product vision, feature roadmap, and operational strategy for pay-in and pay-out flows across our stablecoin rails, working across Sendwave and WorldRemit. You will report to the Head of Product, Stablecoin Wallet.

You will achieve this by:
  • Owning the end-to-end stablecoin wallet.Define and execute the roadmap for the full wallet lifecycle: funding (pay-in), holding, and disbursement (pay-out), including onramp/offramp infrastructure and custody considerations.
  • Building new features in the stablecoin landscape.Identify and ship new capabilities as the space evolves, from new onramp/offramp rails and yield or savings mechanics to multi-currency stablecoin support and new partner integrations. You're not just maintaining the wallet, you're expanding what it can do.
  • Driving pay-in and pay-out reliability. Own the CX and operational north star for how funds enter and exit the wallet. Reduce friction, failed transactions, and settlement delays across markets.
  • Running the operational engine.Partner with Compliance, Risk, and Ops to keep the wallet running cleanly day to day: monitoring, incident response, vendor SLAs, and the unglamorous stuff that keeps money moving without drama.
  • Navigating the regulatory landscape.Work with Legal and Compliance to launch and scale stablecoin capabilities within licensing, AML/BSA, and EDD requirements across our operating markets.
  • Driving growth in focus markets.Collaborate with Growth, Marketing, and Engineering to scale funded wallets in Nigeria, Cameroon, and beyond, balancing speed with compliance and reliability.
  • Presenting to leadership. Own regular updates to senior leadership on the state of the stablecoin wallet: performance against targets, key risks, and the case for what's next. You can turn a messy quarter into a clear, defensible narrative.
  • Owning the growth-versus-risk trade-off. Balance the path to our funded wallet target with the regulatory and reputational exposure a stablecoin product carries. You know when to push and when to slow down.
  • Prioritizing ruthlessly.Make hard calls across a fast-moving feature backlog, and ensure this roadmap fits within the broader Wallets & New Products portfolio rather than running as its own island.
  • Partnering with Engineering on system-level trade-offs. Work with Engineering on build-vs-buy decisions, custody and security posture, and vendor risk, and operate within our quality bar rather than around it.

What you'll bring to the table
  • Crypto and stablecoin fluency (required). Direct experience working in crypto or with stablecoin rails. You understand custody models and the operational realities of moving stablecoins at scale, not just the theory.
  • Fiat and stablecoin on-ramp/off-ramp familiarity (required).You know how money actually moves between fiat and stablecoin rails: banking partners, liquidity providers, conversion mechanics, and where these flows tend to break.
  • A pulse on the stablecoin landscape. You actively track where the space is moving (new issuers, chains, regulatory shifts, competitor launches) and translate that into concrete feature bets rather than just staying informed for its own sake.
  • Deep customer empathy.A track record of putting users first, thinking in terms of end-to-end journeys rather than isolated features.
  • Data-informed decision making.Comfortable with SQL and analytics tools to size opportunities, monitor funnel health, and validate hypotheses.
  • Operational rigor. You don't just design the flow, you own what happens when it breaks. Comfortable with incident response, vendor management, and metrics that matter when real money is moving.
  • Masterful collaborator and communicator.Able to flex between a detailed engineering conversation and an executive brief.
  • Proven delivery and resilience.A history of shipping in a fast-paced environment, comfortable with incomplete information and regulatory ambiguity.

Bonus points if you have
  • Product management experience in fintech, payments, or remittance.
  • Familiarity with international payments regulation across emerging markets (Africa in particular).
  • Experience standing up new payment rails or vendor integrations from scratch.
  • A personal connection to or deep familiarity with the immigrant communities we serve.

AI Literacy & Tools
As Zepz continues to build AI into how we work, we expect everyone to engage with it as a core part of their role. For this position we are looking for:
  • A genuine curiosity about AI and how it can be applied in your area of work — from accelerating analysis and insight generation, to improving how we design and deliver processes and communications.
  • Practical experience using AI tools in a professional context — whether to connect information, draft content, build frameworks, or create insights from data. We want people who actively use AI to increase productivity, not those who are waiting to be told to.
  • Strong AI literacy — an understanding of what AI assistants can and cannot do, how to prompt effectively, and how to critically evaluate AI-generated output before using it.
  • Awareness of the ethical considerations and responsible use of AI in the workplace, particularly in the context of sensitive data, customer experience, and compliance.
  • Prior experience using Claude (Anthropic) is a nice-to-have but not essential — what matters most is that you are genuinely engaged with AI as a tool, comfortable experimenting, and eager to share what works with your wider team

If you want to join us in our journey to help break barriers in financial access and improve lives globally, there's no better place or time to join.

Our global team of 800+ people is spread across six continents. We aspire to hire the best mix of people from former Olympians to YouTube influencers and we speak over twenty languages. This incredible diversity isn't a bonus; it's the engine that lets us serve the world.

Ready to Apply? Let’s Go.

Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the role:

At Cresta, the AI Agent team is on a mission to create state-of-the-art AI Agents that solve practical problems for our customers. We are focused on leveraging the latest technologies in Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI Agent systems, while ensuring that the solutions we develop are cost-effective, secure, and reliable.

As an AI Agent Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of deploying AI agents that address real-world challenges. In this role, you will work closely with customers as well as our software and machine learning engineers, ensuring high-impact AI Agent deployments and contributing to the continuous improvement of our core AI platform. You’ll develop intelligent AI agents, integrate them seamlessly with external systems and offer hands-on technical expertise to ensure successful deployments.. This position requires strong engineering skills, adaptability, and customer engagement. If you are self-driven, analytical, and eager to leverage AI in practical applications, this role is for you.

What You'll Do :

  • AI Agent Development: Develop, configure, deploy, and optimize AI agents using Cresta’s AI platform and tools.
  • System Integration: Build AI agent integrations with external systems (APIs, databases, CRMs, etc.) to ensure seamless workflow integration.

Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams — identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through real-world deployment learnings.

We highly value your time and engineering craftsmanship. To ensure a streamlined and objective process, the first step for qualified applicants following an initial resume review is a self-paced CoderPad technical assessment. Compensation at Cresta

The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. Forecasting & Budgeting

  • Owns the region’s forecasting cycle and annual budget process, partnering with the RVP(s) and Client Services to produce accurate, timely projections and to make the process more efficient each cycle.

Month-End Close & Consolidated Reporting

  • Oversees monthly financial operations for the region — consolidated reporting, reconciliation, accruals, and payroll and expense review — ensuring an accurate, timely close.

Pro Forma & Financial Modeling

  • Builds pro forma models, scenarios, and strategic analyses to support operational decisions, new and expanding practices, and regional planning.

KPI Analysis & Reporting

  • Tracks practice- and unit-level performance across the region — patient volume, provider productivity, revenue and cost per unit, and practice-level margin — and identifies the operational drivers behind the trends.

raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

At Basis, we empower agencies and brands with cutting-edge software that automates digital media operations. Our all-in-one platform supports seamless planning, reporting, and financial reconciliation across direct, programmatic, search, and social media.
We’re not just building advanced technology; we’re also building a culture where passionate, motivated individuals come together to drive meaningful change. Our commitment to inclusivity and growth ensures our employees thrive both professionally and personally.
With our headquarters in Chicago, we offer flexible work options across the U.S. and Canada, including remote, hybrid, or on-site at headquarters.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our team sits at the nexus between the flagship Basis Platform application and our Demand-Side Platform, a real-time auction engine that competes in billions of ad auctions a day, each with a sub-100ms latency.

We implement features and workflows that surface the DSP capabilities making the functionality approachable for the novice and power users alike. The work is high-visibility, revenue-impacting, and customer-facing. The features and projects we take on reach across internal and external boundaries, services, and orgs. We deal in data, and lots of it! Implementation is not just code and structure, we consider resources, performance, and scalability.

WAYS YOU’LL CONTRIBUTE

You'll build net-new Basis Platform features, develop the integrations that bridge Basis Platform and our DSP, and extend the existing feature sets that our customers rely on every day. What makes you a great fit for the team:

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

    • 5+ years professional software development experience.

    • Proven experience designing, building, and scaling modern, production‑level front‑end experiences using React, with supporting back‑end work in Ruby on Rails.

    • Current with modern development practices, including AI-assisted and agentic workflows for code generation, debugging, exploring, and documentation.

    • Strong grasp of data modeling and system design.

    • Enthusiastic growth-oriented mindset.

BONUS POINTS

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field

    • Experience with Spring Boot, Quarkus

    • Excited by a fast-paced product development environment

    • Passion for Ad-Tech

OUR TECH STACK

    • React/JS, Ruby/Rails, Java

    • PostgreSQL, MySql, Redis, MongoDB

    • Docker, Kubernetes, AWS

    • Kafka, RabbitMQ

Integrity in Hiring

At Basis, integrity is at the core of how we hire. To protect our candidates and our company, we verify identity, education, and employment history for all hires. Some roles may also require onsite or in-person interviews as part of the process. Any misrepresentation of identity, experience, or skills may result in removal from the hiring process or termination of employment. We value transparency and authenticity and expect the same from every applicant.

Anything Else?

Don’t have every skill listed? No problem! We know experience can be built in many ways. If you have relevant skills that aren't reflected in your resume, we encourage you to share them in an optional cover letter.

Life With Basis

We’re committed to our people’s growth and well-being because our success is tied to theirs. That’s why we’ve earned recognition as a top workplace, including: Ad Age, #1 Best Places to Work, WorkLife's #1 Most Committed to Work Life Balance, and the Chicago Tribune's Top Workplaces in Chicago. We offer competitive perks, including a flexible work week, 401k/RRSP matching, mental health support, paid sabbaticals, generous parental leave, flexible work options, and more.
Basis is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate all team members regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race or cultural background, religion, disability, age, and beyond.
If you need assistance with interview accessibility, please contact @basis.com. Your privacy is important to us, view our policy here.

raw.title: Sr. Principal,  Product Manager - Agentic & Platform
raw.excerpt: We are seeking a Sr.  Principal, Product Manager to own the agentic and platform capabilities of the Conduct platform.
raw.description:
We are seeking a Sr. Principal, Product Manager to own the agentic and platform capabilities of the Conduct platform. This is a senior individual-contributor role. You will set product direction and do the work directly. You will not manage a team. You will lead through technical depth, a high craft bar, and influence across product and engineering.

The mandate has two connected halves. First, define the API, MCP, and headless surfaces that let sophisticated customers and AI agents build on the platform rather than around it. Second, own the non-functional requirements, scale, performance, reliability, multi-tenancy, and security, that the largest regulated financial institutions require to move a deal through diligence. Both require a product leader who treats platform contracts and non-functional requirements as product decisions, not engineering handoffs.

You will own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for this surface, partnering directly with Engineering, AI/ML, Data Science, Professional Services, and the customer-facing organizations to define what the platform is, who it serves, and how it wins.

What you'll do?

    Platform and Agentic Product Strategy

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Conduct’s agentic and platform capabilities: the API, MCP, and headless workflow surfaces that serve both human users and AI agents on a unified workflow layer and audit trail.

  • Define the API surface as product: alert queues, review actions, reason-code taxonomies, workflow configuration, and the programmatic contracts that agents call. These are product decisions, not engineering ones.

  • Build the extensibility model: how sophisticated customers and external or agentic systems build on the platform, including developer-facing documentation and the packaging that frames what is a subscription tier, what is usage-based, and what justifies a premium price point.

  • Partner with the AI/ML product team on the boundary between the intelligence layer and the workflow layer that agents call. Keep the workflow contract clean so agents call the Conduct workflow layer while the intelligence layer powers it from beneath.

    • Non-Functional Requirements and Platform Readiness

  • Own non-functional requirements as first-class product requirements: scale, performance, reliability, and the security posture that Tier 1 financial institutions require in diligence. Treat security, telemetry, and reliability as product surfaces.

  • Translate the diligence and regulatory-examination bar of the world's largest banks into a defensible non-functional roadmap. In a regulated compliance product, a gap in any of these carries real risk.

    • Agentic Workflows

  • Define product requirements for agentic workflows such as review, analyst assist, auto-sampling, and automations, operating on the same behavioral data asset and audit trail as human users.

  • Ensure every agent's action is captured, explainable, and defensible to the same standard as an analyst decision, so the audit trail holds up to regulatory examination.

    • Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Engineering on capacity allocation, release readiness, and operational discipline. You bring specifications complete enough for engineering to build without coming back for clarification.

  • Partner with AI/ML, Data Science, Professional Services, and Customer Experience to translate customer pain into defensible priorities. Show up where customers are, not just where internal stakeholders are.

  • Maintain a clear view of the competitive landscape and develop differentiated positioning grounded in product reality.

    • Technical Leadership and Influence

  • Set the standard for platform and API/MCP product craft on the product team: problem framing, evidence-based prioritization, and outcome measurement. You raise the bar through your own work and through influence, not through direct reports.

  • Mentor product managers on platform and agentic thinking. This is a dotted-line, lead-through-influence role, not a people-management one.

What you’ll bring

  • 10+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping product at enterprise scale.
  • Demonstrated API and platform product ownership: you have defined and owned developer-facing API surfaces or extensibility layers as product decisions and written the specs to prove it.
  • Demonstrated non-functional requirements ownership: you have shipped products where scale, performance, reliability, or security were product requirements you owned, not issues you delegated to engineering.
  • Experience building for both human and programmatic or agentic consumers, or a strong adjacent track record. Familiarity with agent frameworks or MCP-style surfaces is a plus.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS products in regulated industries. You understand what it means to ship software where wrong answers create legal or regulatory exposure.
  • A track record of leading through technical authority and influence without formal reports. You have set direction and standards that others followed because of the quality of your work, not your title.
  • Strong written communication. You write product specs that engineering can build from and strategy documents that executives can act on. These are different documents and you know the difference.
  • Experience working in a cross-functional model with Engineering, Design, and Data Science as genuine peers, not as service organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in financial services, compliance, legal technology, or another domain where AI explainability and auditability are not optional.
  • Experience commercializing AI or ML capabilities: translating model performance into product value, and product value into pricing and packaging decisions.
  • Experience managing products with both a UI surface and a developer-facing surface simultaneously. The two require different decision frameworks, and you have operated in both.
  • Experience with agent frameworks, MCP, or bring-your-own-model style extensibility as a product concern.

What do we offer?

  • Healthcare insurance: We provide medical, dental, and vision insurance, and a flexible spending account that allows you to set aside pre-tax dollars to pay for eligible out-of-pocket expenses.
  • Stock options.
  • Personal time off: A healthy work-life balance is critical to your success at the office. Smarsh offers a “take-what-you-need” time off policy as well as flexible work arrangements.
  • 401K Match: Smarsh provides a 4% 401K match for which employees are fully vested on day one.
  • Sabbatical: The Smarsh sabbatical programme provides a time to recharge, study or simply do something you are passionate about away from the workplace. Employees are eligible after six years of service.
  • Recognition: We’re big on kudos for a job well done. Our employee-recognition programme enables co-workers to nominate their peers who best embody our core values for recognition.
Don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway! We value diverse candidates and encourage applications, even if you don't perfectly match the job description. Studies have shown that some strong candidates may self-select out of the interview process prematurely, at Smarsh we encourage an inclusive, high-performing environment.
Smarsh is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to their race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. Smarsh invites all qualified interested applicants to apply for career opportunities. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. raw.description:
Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection.

Reports to: Director of Engineering

Location: Toronto, Canada or United States (Remote)

About the Role

    Backcountry is looking for a senior engineer to own the architecture, development, and reliability of the web applications powering our ecommerce business — the customer-facing storefront, the back-office operations platform, and the supporting services that connect them. As Senior Software Engineer, Ecommerce Web Applications, you will work primarily in PHP applications (a Symfony-based storefront and a Laravel back-office platform), shape the front-end experience with JavaScript and CSS, and drive technical direction that the rest of the team builds on.

    Within your first 6–12 months you will have delivered measurable improvements to system reliability and performance, reduced technical debt in legacy components, established patterns that lift the whole team's delivery velocity, and become a trusted technical leader others turn to. AI coding tools are core to how this team works — you will use AI-assisted development daily, raise the bar for how the team leverages it, and help define the workflows, patterns, and guardrails that make AI-augmented engineering effective and safe.

    This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

What You'll Do

  • Drive architecture, hands-on development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support across PHP web applications (a Symfony-based customer storefront and a Laravel back-office platform).
  • Lead front-end direction with JavaScript (including jQuery) and CSS to deliver responsive, accessible, high-performing customer experiences.
  • Champion and evolve the team's AI-assisted development workflows: use AI tools daily, share techniques, and raise the bar for how effectively and responsibly the team uses them.
  • Own the data layer: design and optimize queries and schema interactions against relational databases (SQL Server and PostgreSQL) and supporting services.
  • Set and uphold engineering standards through code review, mentorship, testing practices, and clear technical documentation (design docs, runbooks, onboarding material).
  • Improve reliability, observability, alerting, and incident response for mission-critical, customer-facing systems.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify legacy components, reduce technical debt, and deliver long-term efficiency gains.
  • Break large initiatives into deliverable chunks and clearly communicate status, roadblocks, and dependencies to engineering and product leadership.
  • Partner with Product, QA, and Engineering leadership to ship scalable, user-focused features that elevate business value.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience with a strong ecommerce or high-traffic web application background.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with PHP, including production experience with Symfony and/or Laravel.
  • Strong front-end skills with JavaScript and CSS, and a solid grasp of web fundamentals (HTTP, browser behavior, performance, accessibility).
  • Strong understanding of relational databases and SQL, including query optimization and schema design.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining production systems with real end-to-end ownership.
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI coding tools for development, and the ability to mentor others on using them effectively. This is an AI-development-driven team.
  • Experience with testing practices (unit/integration), Git workflows, and CI/CD.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and a track record of mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience defining or scaling AI-assisted development workflows across a team (agents, prompts, tooling, guardrails).
  • Python experience (Flask or data tooling) for supporting services.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (GCP or AWS).
  • Familiarity with front-end build tools (Webpack / Laravel Mix), package managers (Composer, npm), and templating engines (Blade, Twig).
  • Experience with event-driven or message-based architectures (e.g., RabbitMQ / AMQP).
  • Experience improving observability and monitoring (structured logging, dashboards, tracing).
  • Experience modernizing or incrementally refactoring legacy codebases.

Why Join

    The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

  • Cross-Functional Impact: Your work on the storefront and operations platform directly affects how customers shop and how internal teams operate — touching product, QA, and engineering leadership daily.
  • AI-First Skill Building: This is an AI-development-driven team. You will use modern AI coding tools every day and help define the workflows, patterns, and guardrails that make the whole team more effective.
  • End-to-End Ownership: Own architecture decisions, technical direction, and delivery for customer-facing systems. Set the patterns the team builds on and mentor other engineers.
  • Competitive Benefits (United States): We offer an attractive benefits package including primarily remote work, private medical and life insurance, additional paid time off, monthly allowances and reimbursements, employee discounts, and opportunities for professional growth.
  • Competitive Benefits (Canada): Paid time off policies, RRSP match, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a variety of supplemental benefit options, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.

Interview Process

    1. Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
    2. Hiring Manager Interview - A deeper conversation with the Manager, MotoSport Technology focused on architecture & ownership, technical leadership / mentorship, and AI-assisted development vision.
    3. Technical Discussion Panel - A technical conversation covering Ecommerce system design, PHP/Symfony/Laravel & SQL depth, debugging, and AI-in-practice with an engineering panel.
    4. Team Conversation - Discuss collaboration, mentorship, code-review judgment, cross-functional communication with team members across functions.
    5. Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
    6. Potential In-Person Interview
    7. Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

    Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

The CSC Generation family of brands is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, please contact .

About Us

Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. At G-P, we’re dedicated to breaking down barriers to global business and creating opportunities for everyone, everywhere.

Our diverse, remote-first teams are essential to our success. We empower our Dream Team members with flexibility and resources, fostering an environment where innovation thrives and every contribution is valued and celebrated.

The work you do here will positively impact lives around the world. We stand by our promise: Opportunity Made Possible. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we invite you to join us in expanding your skills and helping to reshape the future of work.

At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all.

About The Position:

We are seeking a highly motivated, resilient, and results-driven Outbound Business Development Representative to join our fast-growing company. In this role, you won't be waiting for leads to come to you—you will be the engine driving our front-line growth. As an Outbound BDR, you will focus strictly on net-new business acquisition, identifying high-value targets, mapping out key decision-makers, and executing rigorous cold outreach strategies.

The ideal candidate is a true hunter with a passion for the thrill of the chase, excellent objection-handling skills, and a strategic mindset for penetrating cold accounts. This is an exciting opportunity to be a critical pipeline driver in a high-growth SaaS environment.

What You Will Do:

  • Drive Outbound Pipeline: Proactively prospect, map, and penetrate target accounts using a mix of multi-channel outreach, including high-volume cold calling, personalized email sequences, LinkedIn video/voice notes, and other creative social selling tactics.
  • Execute Strategic Account Mapping: Research enterprise and mid-market organizations to identify key decision-makers (C-level, HR Leaders, CFOs) and uncover hidden pain points related to global expansion.
  • Own the First Touch: Conduct high-impact discovery conversations with cold prospects, effectively educating them on G-P’s Employer of Record (EOR) value proposition, overcoming initial friction, and booking qualified meetings for the Account Executive team.
  • Manage Objections: Confidently navigate gatekeepers and handle complex objections regarding global payroll, compliance, and competing solutions.
  • Data-Driven Prospecting: Maintain meticulous records of your outreach sequences, account maps, and conversion metrics within our CRM (Salesforce) and sales engagement tools (e.g., Outreach/Salesloft).
  • Market Intelligence: Stay ahead of macroeconomic trends, geopolitical shifts, and competitor movements to sharply position G-P as the definitive global employment solution.
  • Hit the Numbers: Consistently meet or exceed monthly quotas for cold outreach activity, qualified opportunities generated, and pipeline contribution.

What We Are Looking For:

  • The Hunter Mindset: Proven track record in a pure outbound sales development, lead generation, or cold-calling heavy role (SaaS experience highly preferred).
  • Resilience & Grit: High emotional intelligence with the ability to handle rejection professionally, pivot strategies quickly, and maintain high energy throughout the day.
  • Prospecting Skills: Will to learn and use tools (e.g. Cognism, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach, Salesforce,).
  • Elite Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to write highly personalized, compelling cold copy that cuts through the noise.
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to understand complex business models and articulate how a global EOR platform solves specific corporate expansion pain points.
  • Self-Starter: Highly organized, disciplined, and capable of managing a high volume of outbound activity independently in a remote-first environment.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with the Employer of Record industry, HR outsourcing, global payroll, or workforce management is a massive plus but not essential
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field is preferred but not essential

The annual gross fixed pay range for this position is €33,600 - €41,250 plus variable compensation.

Our ranges are established using objective market benchmarking data for this level of work. Final placement within the range is determined by gender-neutral criteria, including the candidate's relevant skills, experience, and specific qualifications for the role.

Actual compensation for this position may vary and will depend on multiple factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. For Full-Time Regular Employees, this position is also eligible for additional compensation as follows:

  • Sales Roles: This position is eligible for a commission structure in addition to base salary.
  • Non-Sales Roles: This position is eligible for an annual bonus which is paid dependent on various factors, including and without limitation, individual and company performance in addition to base salary.

Benefits

G-P values its employees and offers excellent benefits and perks including generous paid parental leave, flexible time off, spending accounts, medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, sabbatical after 5 years and more.

Individuals residing, or applying to work, in theUnited States: California or Philadelphia,Pennsylvania,please review the following additional information:

G-P will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act, Los Angeles City Fair Chance Act Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Act Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Act Ordinance. Los Angeles applicants can review additional information regarding the Los Angeles City Fair Chance Act here:Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and Philadelphia applicants can review information pertaining to Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Record Screening Standards Ordinance here:Fair Chance Poster. Any consideration of a candidate’s background check with arrest or conviction records will include an individualized assessment based on the factors required by applicable law, including the candidate’s specific record and the duties and requirements of the specific job.

G-P. Global Made Possible.

G-P is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, and we are committed to building and maintaining a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity. We prohibit discrimination and harassment against employees or applicants on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

G-P also is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply for these positions. If you need an accommodation due to a disability during the interview process, please contact us at .

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

Responsibilities

  • Set the product direction and roadmap for margin financing & securities lending and clearing & settlement systems within the core trading infrastructure.
  • Own the architecture design of clearing and settlement systems — trade clearing, position and balance settlement, multilateral netting, fee and interest settlement, and reconciliation.
  • Improve core margin systems including collateral valuation, cross/isolated margin logic, interest accrual, borrow/lend flows, and liquidation handling.
  • Work with the trading engineering teams to turn complex financing and settlement needs into scalable technical solutions.
  • Lead the full product lifecycle from planning to release and ongoing/new feature launch.
  • Monitor system performance, settlement integrity, and reconciliation accuracy; identify and resolve issues before they impact users.
  • Ensure systems comply with standards, regulations, and best practices.

Requirements

  • Deep understanding of margin financing / securities lending mechanics and clearing & settlement flows (netting, reconciliation, collateral management, interest accrual).
  • Experience designing or owning the architecture of clearing/settlement or margin systems, in either TradFi or crypto.
  • Technical or quantitative background (e.g., CS, Financial Engineering, Math).
  • Ability to understand trading logics, risk methods, and settlement flows, and translate them into product requirements.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Product experience is not a must as long as you're interested in the job and you have past experience working on systems level tasks.
  • Proficiency in Mandarin is preferred to coordinate with global stakeholders and overseas partners.

Why Binance

• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)
Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

  5. Comfort working independently in a remote project-based environment.
  6. Adaptability to quickly learn project guidelines and adjust deliverables accordingly.
  7. Interest in the development and ethical use of artificial intelligence technologies.

raw.description:
Job Title: Household Data Specialist - Video Capture (Vietnam)

Job Type: Contractor

Location: Remote, Vietnam-based.

Job Summary

Help train the next generation of personal robotics. You'll capture high-quality video demonstrations of everyday household tasks using a UMI gripper, a wearable device that mimics a robot's hand while letting you perform tasks naturally. Your demonstrations become training data that teaches robots how to operate in real homes.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Capture and submit high-quality, specification-compliant video demonstrations of everyday household tasks using a UMI gripper wearable device.
  2. Follow detailed, task-specific instructions to ensure all recordings meet rigorous project standards.
  3. Review feedback from assigned reviewers and iteratively refine your approach to improve data quality.
  4. Operate and set up recording equipment and the UMI gripper to accurately mimic real-world hand movements while performing tasks.
  5. Communicate proactively and clearly with the customer’s project team, both in writing and verbally.
  6. Maintain a consistent weekly workflow to meet the minimum approved data requirements.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  1. Keen attention to detail and demonstrated ability to follow complex specifications precisely.
  2. Manual dexterity and experience with physical task precision in varied household environments.
  3. Comfort with operating, wearing, and setting up specialized devices and recording equipment.
  4. Capacity to incorporate feedback and make iterative improvements to processes and outputs.
  5. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including openness to prompt feedback exchanges.
  6. Reliable access to a fully equipped Vietnamese household environment (kitchen, living spaces, and common items).
  7. Ability to upload large video files via stable, high-speed internet from your home environment.
  8. This role involves prolonged use of a VR headset; candidates should be comfortable with extended wear as part of their regular work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Genuine curiosity about personal robotics, AI, and emerging technology in home environments.
  2. Prior experience participating in data collection, usability studies, or similar hands-on projects.
  3. Patience for repetitive, precision-oriented work and willingness to adapt as project needs evolve.

Compensation structure

This is a Pay-Per-Task (PPT) project. You're paid per hour of approved data that meets the project specifications, with an initial rate per approved hour during the pilot phase and an improved rate and per approved hour after calibration, once quality benchmarks are consistently met.

As a planning benchmark, expect roughly 2 hours of review work per 1 hour of approved data early on, an effective rate of a fixed hourly rate at the pilot stage. That ratio typically improves with familiarity, and the post-calibration rate compounds the upside.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours, so we're looking for teammates who are ready to jump in. If selected, we'd love for you to start your first task as soon as you move forward with your application. The expectation is to begin completing tasks within ~24 hours of completing onboarding.

Equipment Requirements

  1. This project involves performing household tasks while wearing a VR headset and a pair of wearable hand-tracking gloves that capture your hand movements and the visual demonstration. All equipment will be shipped to you at no cost, with full setup and usage instructions provided during onboarding. Please ensure your home environment meets the space, lighting, and connectivity requirements covered during onboarding.

Bragi was founded in 2013 and launched the world's first Truly Wireless Earphones in 2015 (yes, a whole 12 months before the Airpods...)

Since then, we have evolved from a promising startup to a market-moving creator of innovative technology, opening the new category of Truly Wireless Earphones. Bragi transformed into a software enabler for consumer brands, focusing on scaling its technology after investing more than $90 million in software and AI.

Now we are a leader in the AI headphone space, known for our smart devices that integrate seamlessly into users' lives. With a focus on innovation and user experience, we are driving the evolution of wearable technology.

Technical Sales Support – Shenzhen-based

We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Technical Sales Support to join our team in China. You will be responsible, together with the sales team, for winning new customers, managing our existing ones, and developing our business with semiconductor companies (SoCs), ODMs, and design houses (IDH). You will work closely with the headquarters in Europe and other team members to win and develop business with the biggest brands and players in the industry.

This is a remote role based in Shenzhen, China

Tasks

  • Identify new business opportunities, generate leads, and implement business development initiatives for domestic and overseas audio brands
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers and partners (SoC, ODM, IDH) to provide tailored solutions and ensure positive experiences
  • Conduct market research to track industry trends and competitors
  • Provide technical support and expertise during the sales and business development process, including product demonstrations, reports, technical presentations, and training sessions
  • Travel within Guangdong province (including Zhuhai, Dongguan, Shenzhen, etc.) and occasionally to other locations nationally and internationally for customer meetings, trade shows, and industry events
  • Manage ODM and IDH data in CRM systems, develop and maintain ODM partnerships, and act as a liaison between Western brand customers and Eastern supply chain partners

Requirements

  • 2-4 years of experience in sales engineering, technical sales, project management, or international sales
  • Experience in the consumer electronics industry is required; a background with ODMs or IDHs is preferred
  • Strong technical knowledge of embedded systems, hardware/software technologies, or manufacturing processes in the audio or consumer electronics domain
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships
  • Native Mandarin speaker, fluent in English

Benefits

  • A platform product that is extremely technically challenging and will change how audio is consumed forever
  • Work in a creative, dynamic, and game-changing environment alongside many talented colleagues
  • Be part of the founding team in China and grow together with our rapidly expanding CN operations
  • Collaborate directly with global leading brands and top Audio & Cloud Software Service Providers
  • Help us develop the future of Audio Devices and Audio Apps, delivering magical experiences to 25M+ users in the next 12 months (existing base is 10M+)
  • Opportunities to attend and represent us at international events and trade shows
  • A flexible Learning & Development program—choose where you want to improve yourself
