raw.title: Customer Onboarding Manager
raw.excerpt: At ShiftCare, our Customer Onboarding Managers help new customers successfully implement ShiftCare, adopt best-practice workflows, and get value from the platform as quickly as possible.
raw.description:
At ShiftCare, our Customer Onboarding Managers help new customers successfully implement ShiftCare, adopt best-practice workflows, and get value from the platform as quickly as possible.

This is not a passive support role. We are looking for someone confident, proactive, highly organised, and comfortable managing a high-volume onboarding workload across calls, meetings, follow-ups, HubSpot tasks, training sessions, and customer problem-solving.

You will work with customers ranging from small providers with 5 seats through to larger teams with 100+ seats, helping each customer set up ShiftCare in a way that supports their business, improves their workflows, and gives them confidence from day one.

Grow With Us

We are looking for a PH-based, full-time, dedicated, and passionate Customer Onboarding Manager to join our growing Customer Success team.

You will be a core member of our onboarding function, working closely with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product, and Operations to deliver a high-quality onboarding experience for every new customer.

This role is remote, but you must be able to work Australian Eastern Standard Time hours, 9am–6pm AEST.

What You’ll Do

1. Customer Onboarding & Implementation

  • Lead onboarding for new ShiftCare customers, from smaller teams of around 5 seats through to larger customers with 100+ seats.
  • Guide customers through setup, training, workflow design, and best-practice implementation.
  • Run onboarding calls, training sessions, check-ins, and follow-up meetings with confidence and structure.
  • Help customers understand how to use ShiftCare effectively based on their business needs and operating model.
  • Identify potential blockers early and take ownership of getting customers back on track.

2. Workflow Problem-Solving

  • Work through complex customer scenarios and translate them into practical ShiftCare workflows.
  • Ask strong discovery questions to understand each customer’s operational needs.
  • Help customers make good decisions about setup, roles, permissions, processes, scheduling, billing, and care operations.
  • Distinguish between training gaps, workflow issues, user error, bugs, and feature requests.
  • Escalate issues clearly and appropriately when support from other teams is needed.

3. High-Volume Customer Communication

  • Manage a busy onboarding workload across calls, meetings, follow-ups, and admin tasks.
  • Stay organised while handling multiple customers at different stages of onboarding.
  • Communicate proactively with customers so they know what is happening, what is expected of them, and what comes next.
  • Keep momentum high during onboarding and avoid letting customers drift or stall.
  • Be comfortable making calls, following up directly, and driving customers toward completion.

4. HubSpot Ownership & CRM Hygiene

  • Maintain accurate and detailed onboarding records in HubSpot.
  • Keep notes, next steps, customer status, meeting outcomes, risks, and follow-up tasks up to date.
  • Use HubSpot consistently to manage your pipeline, prioritise work, and provide visibility to the wider team.
  • Treat CRM hygiene as a core part of the role, not an admin afterthought.
  • Ensure leadership can clearly understand the status, risks, and progress of your onboarding customers.

5. Training, Enablement & Content

  • Deliver clear, confident product training to customers in live sessions.
  • Create or contribute to customer-facing enablement content such as short videos, walkthroughs, webinars, templates, and help resources.
  • Be comfortable explaining product concepts simply and clearly to different customer types.
  • Support customers in adopting underused or newly released features.
  • Look for opportunities to improve the onboarding experience through better resources, repeatable processes, and scalable training.

6. Continuous Improvement

  • Share customer feedback, onboarding patterns, common blockers, and product insights with the wider team.
  • Help improve onboarding playbooks, templates, processes, and internal documentation.
  • Identify ways to make onboarding more efficient without reducing customer quality.
  • Contribute to a high-performance onboarding culture focused on outcomes, accountability, and customer success.

Who You Are

You are proactive, confident, organised, and comfortable taking ownership. You do not wait for customers or internal teams to chase you. You drive the process forward.

  • A strong communicator who is confident leading customer calls and training sessions.
  • Highly organised and able to manage a high-volume workload of meetings, calls, follow-ups, and CRM tasks.
  • Proactive, with the ability to spot risks early and take action before problems grow.
  • A strong problem solver who enjoys working through complex customer scenarios.
  • Comfortable onboarding both small and larger customers, from 5-seat accounts through to 100+ seat teams.
  • Experienced with HubSpot, with strong CRM discipline and attention to detail.
  • Confident documenting customer progress, risks, next steps, and outcomes.
  • Comfortable creating or appearing in customer-facing videos, webinars, or training content.
  • Tech-savvy, curious, and genuinely interested in engaging deeply with the product.
  • Quick to learn new systems, tools, and product concepts, and willing to explore how features work so you can guide customers with confidence.
  • Patient and empathetic, while still being confident enough to guide customers firmly.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced SaaS or startup environment.
  • Accountable, reliable, and willing to take ownership of customer outcomes.
  • Someone who wants to build a long-term career with ShiftCare and grow with the team.

What You’ll Need

  • 2+ years of experience in onboarding, implementation, customer success, training, support, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
  • Proven experience leading customer calls, training sessions, or implementation meetings.
  • Strong experience using HubSpot or a similar CRM, with excellent hygiene and documentation habits.
  • Strong English communication skills, especially in phone and video-call environments.
  • Ability to manage a high volume of customer interactions without losing quality or attention to detail.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and comfort dealing with complex customer workflows.
  • A curious mindset and willingness to spend time understanding the product, customer use cases, and better ways of working.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • PH-based and able to work 9am–6pm AEST.
  • High-speed and stable primary and backup internet connection, minimum 10 Mbps.
  • A screenshot of your speed test results will be required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience onboarding customers in SaaS, health-tech, care management, rostering, scheduling, workforce management, or similar platforms.
  • Experience creating customer training videos, webinars, walkthroughs, or enablement content.
  • Experience using tools such as Intercom, ChurnZero, Loom, Zoom, Google Workspace, or Microsoft Office.
  • Experience improving onboarding processes, playbooks, templates, or internal workflows.
  • Exposure to healthcare, aged care, disability care, NDIS, home care, or community services.

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers complete onboarding with confidence and clarity.
  • HubSpot is accurate, up to date, and trusted by the team.
  • Customers understand how to use ShiftCare in their day-to-day operations.
  • Onboarding blockers are identified early and resolved quickly.
  • You manage a high volume of work without letting quality slip.
  • You communicate proactively and clearly with both customers and internal teams.
  • You help improve onboarding processes as the team grows.
  • You actively engage with the product, understand new features, and bring practical ideas back to the team.

Why Join ShiftCare?

  • Fast-Track Growth: Join a growing company where strong performers are recognised and given opportunities to grow quickly.
  • Meaningful Work: Help care providers improve the way they manage their teams, clients, schedules, and operations.
  • Professional Development: Access training, coaching, and opportunities to build your skills across SaaS, onboarding, customer success, product education, and operations.
  • Supportive Team Environment: Work with a team that values ownership, clear communication, customer outcomes, and continuous improvement.
  • Long-Term Opportunity: We are looking for someone who wants to grow with ShiftCare over the next several years, not someone looking for a short-term role.

Final callout: If you are a confident, proactive, and detail-oriented onboarding professional who enjoys solving customer problems, leading calls, managing a busy workload, and helping customers succeed, we encourage you to apply.

We are looking for strong candidates who want to do excellent work, take ownership, and grow with ShiftCare.

raw.excerpt: About BackblazeBackblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators.
raw.description:
About Backblaze

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud - managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We’re seeking a Developer Advocate to join our team!

About The Role

This is a ground-floor developer relations role at a company that is serious about building a DevRel function — not just checking a box. You’ll be the technical voice of Backblaze: creating content, showing up at events, and helping developers understand how to build with Backblaze B2 in the workloads they’re actually running — AI pipelines, media workflows, and data-intensive infrastructure.

You’ll work directly with our Director of Startup & Developer Relations and alongside the Flamethrower Startup Program — Backblaze’s initiative to become the storage layer of choice for early-stage companies. You’ll have support from our product, content, documentation and other teams, as well as consulting budget for structural and strategic scaffolding as we build this out. Your job is to be technically credible, well-connected, and visible.

The right person for this role has been doing this work informally — writing technical content, showing up at conferences, building a following in developer communities — and is ready to make it the job. Or they’ve been doing it formally at the mid-level and want to step up on impact without stepping into program leadership yet.

What You’ll Do:

Technical Content & Education

  • Create technical content that teaches developers how to build with Backblaze B2: tutorials, sample applications, reference architectures, blog posts, and short-form video
  • Build and publish working code examples and demos — especially for AI/ML workflows (training data pipelines, model artifact storage, inference infrastructure), media workflows, and application storage
  • Contribute to and improve developer documentation, SDKs, and quickstart guides
  • Translate what you’re hearing from developers into actionable product feedback for Engineering and Product

Community & Events

  • Be genuinely present in the developer communities where our users live — social media, Discord, Slack, GitHub, and elsewhere
  • Represent Backblaze at developer events: speak, demo, show up, and be worth talking to. We attend conferences across AI/ML, media, cloud infrastructure, and startup ecosystems
  • Build relationships in the AI/ML, media, and cloud infrastructure developer communities that generate inbound awareness for Backblaze
  • Support Flamethrower startup cohort members in getting to production faster — answer technical questions, sanity-check architectures, and document patterns worth sharing broadly

Program Contribution

  • Work closely with the Director of Startup & Developer Relations, as well as our product team, lifecycle marketing, and product marketing to identify common technical blockers and create content that removes them
  • Partner with Marketing on ecosystem storytelling, technical blog strategy, and developer-facing content
  • Maintain a consistent feedback loop from developers to Product — surface friction points, integration gaps, and unmet needs

The Right Fit:

  • 4–7 years of hands-on experience as a software developer or engineer, with meaningful time working with cloud infrastructure and object storage (S3, B2, GCS, or equivalent)
  • Direct experience building or integrating AI/ML workflows that involve storage — training data pipelines, model artifact management, inference infrastructure, or similar workloads
  • You write working code. You may use AI tools to accelerate it — but you understand what you’re shipping and can explain it to another developer
  • An established presence in developer communities — a social following, conference talks, a technical blog, open source contributions, or some combination. We’re not counting followers; we’re looking for signal that you show up and people pay attention
  • Strong written communication: you can write a clear technical tutorial and a crisp internal summary with equal ease
  • Self-directed — you don’t need a content calendar handed to you to know what to build next

Bonus Points For:

  • Familiarity with Backblaze B2 or direct experience with object storage in production environments
  • Experience with media/video workflows, SaaS backend architecture, or data-intensive platform development
  • Prior experience in a formal DevRel capacity — developer advocate, technical evangelist, developer educator — even if it wasn’t your primary title
  • Active in the AI/ML developer ecosystem: Hugging Face, Discord communities, GitHub, X/Twitter, YouTube, or similar channels

Backblaze Perks:

  • Healthcare for family, including dental and vision
  • Competitive compensation and 401K
  • RSU grants for full-time employees
  • ESPP program
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Maternity & paternity leave
  • MacBook Pro to use for work, plus a generous stipend to personalize your workstation
  • Childcare bonus (human children only)
  • Fertility treatment and support
  • Learning & development program
  • Commuter benefits
  • Culture that supports a healthy work-life balance

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

The expected salary range for this role is $96,000 - $136,000.

At Backblaze, we value being fair and good to our customers, partners, and employees. That’s why diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of our values. We are committed to fostering a workforce where all employees feel a sense of belonging regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, socio-economic status, ability, veteran status, and education. We believe that our dedication to cultivating a diverse workspace not only allows us to better serve our customers in over 175 countries but further reinforces our commitment to doing the right thing. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Backblaze Employee Privacy Notice.

raw.description:
About Recast:

Recast Software, located in Minneapolis, MN, empowers organizations to better manage and support users and devices. Our mission is to simplify the work of IT teams and enable them to create highly secure and compliant environments. Our software does this by seamlessly integrating with existing IT infrastructure to quickly remediate issues, ensure compliance, enhance security, and maintain clear visibility across all devices. Recast is a rapidly growing software company with its solution being used by thousands of enterprise organizations in more than 125 countries, impacting millions of devices and (more importantly) the people who use them. 

About the Role:

Recast Software is looking for a Technical Enablement Manager to lead, evolve, and optimize our existing Customer Enablement Program to drive both the depth and breadth of product utilization across our customer base. You'll leverage your extensive experience in ConfigMgr/ MECM/ SCCM and Intune to strengthen and scale established enablement initiatives that help our ever-expanding customer base use the Recast product suite to its full potential. Deploying and refining curriculum at scale, you'll reach thousands of users to train and certify them on Recast's product. Your work will be integral for all customers, from getting brand new customers familiar with the tools, to helping our most advanced users expand their utilization of products they've used for years.

The ideal candidate has expertise in endpoint management with SCCM/ MECM/ ConfigMan and Intune who loves to share their expertise to help other system administrators do their jobs better. Not only are you a natural teacher who breaks down complex topics, so they are understandable and interesting, you're also a constant and curious learner. You enjoy improving and expanding established programs, using data and feedback to refine content, delivery, and outcomes over time.

What You'll Do:

    • Maintain Recast's Customer Enablement Program; reviewing our enablement strategy, crafting the training content, and executing the Program at scale across our growing customer base
    • Build and maintain a library of engaging and effective curriculum; identifying the most important topics to educate our customers and actively filling gaps in our enablement offerings
    • Work with internal Subject Matter Experts to capture and share best practices with our customers
    • Deploy and utilize an enablement platform (NorthPass now Gainsight Customer Education) to disseminate trainings and courses at scale
    • Craft and host live webinars
    • Strive to improve internal and external knowledge bases by investing your learnings back into the enablement program, documentation, and other resources.
    • Develop a deep understanding of Recast’s products, our customers’ environments, and the systems market at large
    • Develop a deep understanding of our customers and how we can best serve their enablement needs
    • Work cross functionally with Customer Success, Support, and Product to prioritize recurring issues for the development team to resolve

What You'll Bring:

    • 3+ years’ experience using ConfigMgr (SCCM), preferably using the Enterprise Right Click Tools
    • 2+ years’ experience using Microsoft Intune
    • Enthusiasm for helping people, especially your peers, get the most value out of tools and products
    • Experience crafting content and leading trainings for a technical audience
    • Exceptional communication, instructional, and presentation skills with strong customer service
    • Comfortable working in multiple platforms and mediums to most effectively deliver instructional content
    • Highly accountable and self-motivated, comfortable owning projects from conception to follow-through while handling competing (and sometimes cross-functional) priorities
    • Strong problem solving and critical thinking skills

What Stands Out:

  • Experience with customer enablement
  • Experience working with external customers
  • Experience in the SaaS industry
  • Experience using enablement platforms (like Skilljar or Gainsight)

What We Value:

  • We take initiative. We have a culture of ownership and progress over perfection. We proactively drive outcomes with self-motivation and determination. We deliver results that matter for our customers and our team.
  • We get curious. Curiosity moves us forward. We ask questions, try new things, and learn from mistakes. Challenges are opportunities to explore creative solutions that benefit our customers and drive continuous improvement.
  • We work together. We appreciate the power of diverse perspectives. Through open communication, we help one another and leverage our collective expertise for better outcomes. We build trust through teamwork.
  • We embrace change. Change is inevitable; we meet it with agility and resilience. We navigate with courage and find possibility in uncertainty. We adapt for the future, shaping our path with purpose.
  • We choose empathy. We aim to deeply understand the needs of our customers and one another - it's the foundation of our relationships. We assume positive intent and practice mutual respect. We prioritize a culture of belonging because success is a shared journey.

What We Offer:

  • The salary range for this position is $90,000-$115,000. Salary offered will vary based on the full context of experience, skills, education, and location/ cost of living
  • 7.5% annual bonus potential
  • Medical, dental, and vision
  • FSA or HSA with company contributions
  • Employer paid STD, LTD, AD&D and life insurance
  • 401k with 4% employer match
  • Work-life balance, flexible time off, and remote work options
  • Parental leave

Why we love working at Recast:

It takes great people across an entire company to build great tools. As a growing start-up, every employee has an opportunity to make a huge impact on our business, as well as ample opportunities to learn and grow. We are a people-first culture with passionate, talented, and supportive teammates. We are committed to making every employee feel respected and valued. We recognize to bring our best selves to Recast, it’s important for everyone to nurture their lives outside of work.

raw.excerpt: CampusWorks is redefining how higher education institutions use technology and functional managed services to drive transformation, financial sustainability, and student success.
raw.description:
CampusWorks is redefining how higher education institutions use technology and functional managed services to drive transformation, financial sustainability, and student success. We serve as a true end-to-end partner to institutional leaders, delivering a fully integrated model that spans professional and managed services.

We are seeking Data Engineers at both the mid and lead level to build and operate a federated, multi-institution data platform on Azure Databricks and Microsoft Fabric. You will develop the pipelines that move data from Workday and a range of legacy source systems into a governed medallion lakehouse (Bronze / Silver / Gold), delivering clean, reliable, well-modeled data that powers analytics for multiple higher education institutions.

This posting covers two levels. As a Data Engineer, you will build and maintain production pipelines within established patterns. As a Lead Data Engineer, you will act as a senior technical lead — setting engineering standards, owning complex integrations, mentoring engineers, and reviewing code — as a hands-on individual contributor without direct-report responsibility. Please indicate in your application which level best fits your experience.

Responsibilities

    Pipeline development & data modeling

    • Build and maintain batch data pipelines that ingest from Workday (HCM, Finance, Student) and legacy source systems into the Bronze layer

    • Develop transformation logic across Bronze / Silver / Gold layers using Spark, Python, and SQL on Databricks

    • Model data for analytics consumption, balancing performance, reliability, and maintainability

    • Orchestrate and schedule workloads (e.g., Databricks Workflows, Azure Data Factory, or Fabric pipelines) and monitor them for reliability

    • Implement data-quality checks and validation within pipelines

    Platform & governance alignment

    • Work within the federated architecture and Unity Catalog security model, respecting the boundary between institution-administered and centrally managed catalogs

    • Follow the shared transformation standards and reference patterns set by the Solution Architect

    • Contribute to documentation, code reviews, and version-controlled deployment

    Lead-level responsibilities (Lead Data Engineer)

    • Serve as senior technical lead on complex integrations and cross-institution data workstreams

    • Define and enforce engineering standards, patterns, and best practices

    • Mentor and provide technical guidance and code review to other engineers

    • Partner with the Solution Architect and governance leads on design decisions and platform improvements

    The responsibilities listed above are representative of the role and may be adjusted to meet organizational priorities.

Qualifications & Requirements

    • Data Engineer: 3–6 years building production data pipelines. Lead Data Engineer: 7–10 years, with demonstrated technical leadership

    • Hands-on expertise with Apache Spark, Python, and SQL in a Databricks environment

    • Experience designing and building medallion or layered data architectures (Bronze / Silver / Gold or equivalent)

    • Proven experience integrating data from multiple ERP / SIS / operational source systems into an analytics platform

    • Experience with batch pipeline orchestration and scheduling (Databricks Workflows, Azure Data Factory, or similar)

    • Working understanding of data governance, security, and access concepts in a shared or multi-tenant environment

    • Strong problem-solving skills with a consistent focus on data quality and reliability

    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills on a remote team

    • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

    • Microsoft Fabric and/or Power BI experience

    • Data-quality tooling such as Great Expectations — expected for the Lead level

    • Experience with higher education source systems: Workday, Banner (Oracle), Colleague (SQL Server), Jenzabar, PowerFAIDS

    • Unity Catalog experience and familiarity with CI/CD for data (Git-based workflows, DevOps pipelines)

    • Exposure to streaming or near-real-time ingestion patterns

    • Databricks certification (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer)

What You Can Expect from Us

At CampusWorks, we don't just help our clients succeed; we help our employees succeed. Competitive pay, robust benefits for full-time employees, and professional development opportunities are a few of the many reasons that CampusWorks is a great place to build your career.
Our employees enjoy:
Meaningful work. Our employees often tell us that their work gives them a sense of purpose because it makes a difference in the lives of students and educators. CampusWorks Inc., as a large consulting firm, provides its employees with an opportunity to work both onsite and remotely with our clients across the United States and in Canada. With the nature of our clients’ work evolving quickly, we’re all being asked to support larger CampusWorks initiatives. Upon joining CampusWorks in a consulting role, your talent and expertise may be applied to a range of projects, assignments, and clients.
A CEO who cares. Chairman and CEO Liz Murphy has made it her mission to create a culture that appreciates and takes good care of its people. As a result, being an employee of CampusWorks feels like being a member of a big family.
A virtual and onsite workplace. In an effort to reduce our environmental footprint, CampusWorks became a virtual company in 2012. As such, our team members are located across the U.S. and Canada, where they work from their home offices and at client sites.
Flexibility. We value work-life balance because we know that happy employees create happy customers. That's why CampusWorks offers both full-time and part-time 1099 consulting career opportunities to fit life's unique demands.
A company that gives back. Every year CampusWorks proudly supports numerous charitable fundraising initiatives that align with our vision to make higher education accessible to everyone.
At CampusWorks, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives each CampusWorker (we call ourselves CampusWorkers) brings to our workplace each day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you are passionate about higher education and creating Happy Campuses, let's talk! If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying.

About CampusWorks

Founded in 1999, CampusWorks is dedicated to helping higher education overcome business and technological challenges that stand in the way of student success and completion. We work with community colleges, technical colleges, four-year public and private institutions, multi-college districts, and statewide higher education systems to tackle problems big and small. Our services are rooted in systems thinking and reach across the institution—from Student Services to Human Resources to Finance to Academics—to achieve transformative results.
Want to learn more about life at CampusWorks? Visit to see how we empower Higher Education to reach its full potential

raw.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.What this opportunity involves:
We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 8+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paidEffort estimate

Tasks for this project are estimated to take 30 hours to complete, depending on complexity. This is an estimate and not a schedule requirement; you choose when and how to work. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation:
Up to $150/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~30 hours each; you set your own schedule.

Wheelhouse DMG is a sought-after digital marketing agency that has worked with some of the world’s most innovative healthcare, medical device, and privacy-first brands for more than a decade. We consistently deliver exceptional business value through a combination of deep marketing expertise, purpose-built technology, and creative capabilities. As platform automation and privacy regulations disrupt traditional marketing initiatives, much of our work focuses on helping healthcare and MedTech organizations drive performance in a first-party data world.

Examples of our work include:

  • Unlocking performance for a medical device client by employing sophisticated first-party data strategies
  • Developing and implementing HIPAA-compliant data strategies for healthcare and MedTech clients
  • Reimagining the appointment booking experience to create exponential growth for one of the largest healthcare systems in the U.S.
  • Leading strategy for the consolidation of 2.5 million web pages on 39 NASA websites into a single, unified information architecture and content strategy for NASA’s Science Directorate

About This Listing

Not every great candidate comes along at exactly the right moment — and we know that. This listing isn't for a specific open role. It's an invitation.

Whether you've been keeping an eye on Wheelhouse, came across us through a colleague, or went through our process and just missed the timing — we want to hear from you. Submitting here puts your resume in front of our People & Culture team so that when the right opportunity opens, we already know who you are.

We also use this space internally. If a hiring manager reviews a strong candidate who isn't the right fit for a current role, we route that resume here and follow-up for future opportunities. No one gets forgotten in a folder.

Who We're Looking For

We don't have a single profile in mind — our team spans disciplines and experience levels. That said, the people who thrive at Wheelhouse tend to share a few things in common:

  • A genuine passion for digital marketing and a drive to stay ahead of industry changes
  • Comfort working with data and an appreciation for what it can tell you
  • A collaborative, team-first mindset — we partner closely, internally and with clients
  • Strong communication skills, especially in remote or async environments
  • Intellectual curiosity and a lifelong learner's approach to their craft
  • High emotional intelligence and a commitment to kind, thoughtful feedback

We work across a range of practice areas including Digital Advertising, Digital Strategy, Analytics & Data Engineering, Marketing, Business Development, Account Management and more. If your background touches any of these areas, we'd love to have your resume on file.

What Happens When You Apply

Our People & Culture team reviews every submission. Here's how it works:

  • If your background is a strong match for a role we're actively hiring for, we'll reach out directly.
  • If the timing isn't right but we'd love to stay connected, we'll add your profile to our talent pool and circle back when something opens up that fits.
  • We make every effort to review submissions and follow up when there's a fit.

We know that applying takes effort, and we don't take that lightly. We'll do our best to be responsive and transparent about where things stand.

Beyond Experience: About You
You know digital marketing from every angle. You've earned a reputation as a T-shaped marketer, someone with deep expertise in your core discipline and the range to connect it to every other piece of the puzzle. You're always looking for the link between a tactic and the business goal it's meant to serve, and that focus on performance shows up in the results you deliver.

You'd rather enable your teammates than direct them. You thrive in collaborative work, the kind that fills up a whiteboard during a good brainstorm, and you listen closely for ways to help clients succeed, whether that's a new tactic worth testing, a piece of work worth proposing, or a better way to collaborate. You bring real emotional intelligence to the table, especially when it comes to delivering feedback with care.

You're helpful, generous, and empathetic, and you find real joy in helping others succeed. Wheelhouse's values aren't aspirational for you; they're already how you work. There's no room for cynicism here, and you wouldn't want there to be.

What Wheelhouse offers:
  • A passionate, joyful, values-driven company with a remote-first culture.
  • An exciting, creative, and fast-paced atmosphere
  • Competitive salary with semi-annual review processes
  • Company-sponsored Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for the employee and their dependents
  • Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance and AD&D Benefits
  • Access to the Company’s Employee Assistance Program
  • Quarterly volunteering and donation match
  • $50 monthly Wellness stipend
  • $1000 annual Professional Development & Education credit
  • Joy Fund of $50 per month that can be spent on anything that brings joy to a Wheelhouse employee or client
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Generous Company Holidays
  • Monthly Mental Health Days for employees to rest and recharge
  • 3 months of 100% paid parental leave with a two-week re-entry period
  • Participation in the Wheelhouse 401k program, including 100% match up to 4% of salary
  • Participation in a Student Loan Assistance program
At Wheelhouse DMG, we believe that our differences add to the richness of our experience together. This means we not only welcome diversity; we celebrate it! Your gender identity, your religion, your skin color, and where you come from are essential to who you are and will be welcomed here. We believe that by fostering a culture of inclusion where everyone is able to bring their whole selves to work, we will create a place where everyone feels like they belong and are valued for who they are. We have an ongoing commitment to diversity and equal opportunity for all applicants and employees. Come as you are, everyone is welcomed here -- but don’t forget to apply!

Job Purpose

WRS Health is seeking a strategic, technically fluent sales executive to lead our enterprise sales organization and Sales Engineering function. This executive will drive revenue growth, enterprise customer acquisition, and technical pre-sales execution while serving as the bridge between complex software capabilities and real-world healthcare operations.

The ideal candidate has deep experience selling healthcare technology solutions—such as EHR/EMR, Practice Management, Revenue Cycle Management, or Health IT platforms—and the ability to translate technical concepts into meaningful clinical, operational, and financial outcomes for healthcare organizations. This role partners closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Executive Leadership to accelerate WRS Health’s growth across physician groups, specialty practices, and healthcare enterprises.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Leadership

  • Develop and execute the enterprise sales strategy to achieve revenue growth targets.
  • Lead, recruit, coach, and scale a high-performing team of Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Business Development Representatives.
  • Establish forecasting, pipeline management, KPIs, and performance metrics that improve revenue predictability.
  • Build repeatable sales processes from prospecting through contract execution.
  • Personally lead strategic enterprise opportunities and executive-level negotiations.

Sales Engineering, Healthcare Solution Consulting & AI Technology

  • Lead the Sales Engineering function supporting enterprise software sales.
  • Translate WRS Health’s technical capabilities into clear clinical, operational, and financial value for healthcare organizations.
  • Oversee technical demonstrations, solution architecture discussions, interoperability assessments, and RFP responses.
  • Support complex healthcare integration discussions involving APIs, HL7, FHIR, SSO, EHR integrations, and revenue cycle workflows.
  • Position AI-powered capabilities as practical solutions for healthcare workflow automation and productivity, while implementing AI-assisted sales workflows across the organization.

Revenue Growth & Operations

  • Own qualified pipeline generation, sales conversion, forecasting accuracy, and enterprise revenue growth.
  • Optimize CRM workflows, reporting, sales analytics, and operational dashboards.
  • Develop account segmentation strategies, enterprise playbooks, and strategic partnership initiatives.
  • Work closely with Marketing to improve lead quality, campaign effectiveness, and demand generation performance.

Executive & Customer Engagement

  • Build trusted relationships with healthcare executives, physicians, administrators, IT leaders, and strategic partners.
  • Present ROI-driven business cases that demonstrate measurable improvements in clinical workflows, operational efficiency, compliance, and financial performance.
  • Represent WRS Health at industry conferences, customer events, executive briefings, and healthcare technology forums.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of enterprise B2B software sales experience, with significant experience selling healthcare technology solutions.
  • 5+ years leading enterprise sales teams and Sales Engineering or technical pre-sales organizations.
  • Demonstrated success selling SaaS platforms to healthcare organizations, including physician practices, specialty groups, MSOs, hospitals, or health systems.
  • Deep understanding of healthcare operations, EHR/EMR systems, Practice Management, Revenue Cycle Management, clinical workflows, and healthcare compliance requirements.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand and communicate software architecture, cloud technologies, APIs, integrations, interoperability standards, and AI capabilities.
  • Experience with healthcare interoperability technologies including HL7, FHIR, REST APIs, OAuth, and SSO.
  • Proven ability to build scalable sales processes, improve forecasting accuracy, and consistently exceed revenue targets.
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce and leveraging sales analytics to drive performance.
  • Exceptional executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required.
  • Masters in Business Administration, or Medical Degree (MD/DO) and other advanced degrees is preferred.

Success Metrics

Within the first 12 months, this leader will be expected to:

  • Increase enterprise pipeline generation and qualified opportunity volume.
  • Improve sales conversion rates across the full enterprise sales funnel.
  • Shorten enterprise sales cycles through stronger technical qualification and solution consulting.
  • Build a scalable, high-performing Sales Engineering organization.
  • Successfully implement AI-assisted sales workflows that improve productivity and forecasting accuracy.
  • Expand WRS Health’s presence within physician groups, specialty practices, and enterprise healthcare organizations.
  • Strengthen collaboration between Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success.
  • Achieve year-over-year revenue growth and establish a repeatable enterprise sales methodology.
  • Improve forecast accuracy and overall revenue predictability.

Additional Details

  • Job Type: Full-time - Independent Contractor
  • Location: Remote
  • Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

This job description outlines the general responsibilities of the role and is not exhaustive. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business operations.

raw.excerpt: Uniti is a premier insurgent fiber provider dedicated to enabling mission-critical connectivity across the United States.
raw.description:
Uniti is a premier insurgent fiber provider dedicated to enabling mission-critical connectivity across the United States.

With a steadfast commitment to customer service, operational excellence, and superior network capabilities, Uniti builds, operates and delivers critical fiber-based communications services to connect and empower people and businesses.

The Business Intelligence Principal-Marketing supports Uniti Fiber’s marketing organization by turning market, campaign, customer, and sales data into actionable insights that improve growth, brand awareness, and go-to-market performance. This role serves as a key strategic partner to Marketing, Sales, Product, and Finance by building dashboards, analyzing campaign effectiveness, identifying market opportunities, and helping leadership make data-driven decisions. This position requires strong analytical ability, business judgment, communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reporting for marketing performance, pipeline contribution, campaign ROI, and lead conversion.
  • Analyze customer, prospect, and market data to identify trends, whitespace opportunities, and growth segments for Uniti Fiber.
  • Partner with marketing leadership to measure brand awareness, demand generation performance, and channel effectiveness.
  • Deliver insights on pricing, competitive positioning, customer behavior, and market penetration.
  • Create executive-ready presentations, reports, and recommendations based on data findings.
  • Support forecasting, planning, and annual marketing strategy development with data-backed analysis.
  • Help improve data quality, reporting processes, and workflow efficiency across marketing systems and business tools.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Finance, and Operations to align metrics and reporting definitions.
  • Translate complex data into clear business recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, segmentation, and improved campaign targeting.

Do You Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, analytics, statistics, finance, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • College degree and 8+ years professional level experience with 3-4 years supervisory experience; or 12+ years professional level-related experience with 3-4 years supervisory experience; or an equivalent combination of education and professional level related experience required. Strong experience with BI and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Advanced skills in Excel and experience working with large datasets.
  • Experience with SQL, CRM platforms, and marketing data environments.
  • Strong understanding of funnel metrics, campaign attribution, segmentation, and performance measurement.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple assignments.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and translate analysis into business action.
  • Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in telecommunications, fiber infrastructure, wholesale, enterprise technology, or B2B services.
  • Experience with Salesforce, marketing automation tools, and dashboard development.
  • Familiarity with pricing analysis, market sizing, and competitive intelligence.
  • Experience supporting executive teams with strategic reporting and business reviews.
  • Understanding of KPI development for enterprise sales and marketing organizations.
  • Success in This Role Looks Like
  • Improved visibility into marketing performance and pipeline contribution.
  • Better targeting of high-value customer segments and growth opportunities.
  • Faster, clearer decision-making through accurate dashboards and reporting.
  • Stronger alignment across marketing, sales, and leadership on performance metrics.
  • Actionable insight that helps Uniti Fiber grow market awareness and revenue.

Our Benefits:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance Plans
  • 401K Plan
  • Health & Flexible Savings Account
  • Life and AD&D, Spousal Life, Child Life Insurance Plans
  • Educational Assistance Plan

Uniti is an equal opportunity employer. At Uniti, we celebrate the authenticity and uniqueness of our people and their ideas. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, genetic information, protected veteran status, current military status, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, creed, citizenship status, or any other status protected by law, and to give full consideration to qualified disabled individuals and protected veterans.

Actual base pay for this job will depend on the candidate's primary work location and other factors, such as relevant skills and experience.

Notice to Non-U.S. Citizens:Uniti, as a holder of licenses granted by the Federal Communications Commission, is required to notify and to obtain approval from federal regulatory agencies prior to granting certain system/network access to any non-U.S. citizen personnel. Offers of employment extended to non-U.S. citizens are contingent upon receiving the requisite approval from agencies overseeing compliance. Non-U.S. citizens are required to provide Uniti with the personal identifying information required to obtain the necessary approval prior to accessing certain systems and/or Uniti’s network. If you are not a U.S. citizen, please notify your recruiter or contact HR Legal as soon as possible for information on Uniti’s foreign personnel disclosure and approval requirements. Notice to Applicants: Depending on the position and its job functions, offers of employment may be contingent upon successful completion of certain pre-employment screenings, including but not limited to drug-screen, motor vehicle records check, or other pre-employment screening. All such screenings will be conducted by an external third-party with the Candidate’s written consent and in accordance with federal and state law. Refusal to authorize or submit to a required pre-employment screening may disqualify the candidate from employment. Any misrepresentation during the application or interview process may result in denial of employment, withdrawal of offer, or termination.

raw.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary

Provides support for claims recovery activities including researching claim payment and billing guidelines, audit results, and federal regulations to determine overpayment accuracy and provider compliance. Collaborates with health plans and vendors to facilitate recovery of outstanding overpayments. Monitors and controls backlog and workflow of claims and ensures that claims are settled in a timely fashion and in accordance with cost-control standards.

Essential Job Duties

  • Prepares written provider overpayment notifications and provides supporting documentation such as explanation of benefits (EOBs), claims and attachments.
    • Maintains and reconciles department reports for outstanding payments collected, past-due overpayments, uncollectible claims and autopayment recoveries.
    • Prepares and provides write-off documents that are deemed uncollectible, and ensures collections efforts are exhausted for write-off approval.
    • Researches simple to complex claims payments using tools such as Department of Health and Human Services (DSHS) and Medicare billing guidelines, Molina claims processing policies and procedures, and other resources to validate overpayments made to providers.
    • Completes basic validation prior to offset to include, eligibility, coordination of benefits (COB), standard of care (SOC) and diagnosis-related group (DRG) requests.
    • Enters and updates recovery applications and claim systems for multiple states and prepares/creates overpayment notification letters with accuracy; processes claims as a refund or auto debit in claim systems and in recovery application.
    • Follows department processing policies and procedures including, claims processing (claim reversals and adjustments), claim recovery (refund request letters, refund checks, claim reversals), and reporting and documentation of recovery as explained in departmental Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
    • Responds to provider correspondence related to claims recovery requests and provider remittances where recovery has occurred.
    • Collaborates with finance to complete accurate and timely posting of provider and vendor refund checks and manual check requests to reimburse providers.
    • Supports claims department initiatives to improve overall claims function efficiency.
    • Meets claims department quality and production standards.
    • Completes basic claims projects as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 1 year of experience in a clerical role in a claims, and/or customer service setting - preferably in managed care, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

• Research and data entry skills.

  • Organizational skills and attention to detail.
    • Time-management skills, and ability to manage simultaneous projects and tasks to meet internal deadlines.
    • Customer service experience.
    • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
    • Microsoft Office suite and applicable software programs proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

• Claims recovery experience.

  • Health insurance experience in a managed care setting.

To all current Molina employees: If you are interested in applying for this position, please apply through the Internal Job Board.

Molina Healthcare offers a competitive benefits and compensation package. Molina Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) M/F/D/V

raw.excerpt: About Fable Global enterprises work with Fable to make products more accessible for over one billion people who live with disabilities.
raw.description:
About Fable

Global enterprises work with Fable to make products more accessible for over one billion people who live with disabilities. Our customers include global leaders like Walmart, Slack, and Shopify. Fable was featured on the Forbes Accessibility 100 list in 2025, awarded Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies in Design, and has received accolades from global entities like the World Summit Awards and the UN-endorsed Zero Project.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Campaign Manager to help drive demand generation and pipeline growth through integrated marketing campaigns and events.

Reporting into the Director of Demand Generation, you'll create campaigns that not only engage enterprise buyers but also inspire organizations to make accessibility a strategic priority, helping further Fable's mission of creating better digital experiences for people with disabilities.

You'll also own the planning and execution of our event marketing program, from industry conferences and customer events to executive roundtables and webinars, while ensuring events are part of a broader, integrated campaign.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who enjoys turning ideas into well-executed programs, thrives in fast-paced environments, and loves collaborating with sales teams to create memorable experiences for prospects and customers.

You’re also someone who loves experimenting with technology. You actively look for ways to use AI and automation to streamline workflows, improve performance, and scale your impact.

Responsibilities

  • Build integrated demand generation campaigns using events, digital marketing, outbound, content, and customer advocacy.
  • Collaborate with Sales to develop creative account-based plays that engage both executive buyers and end users.
  • Coordinate campaign execution across channels and measure performance against pipeline goals.
  • Continuously test and optimize campaigns based on engagement and revenue outcomes.
  • Own Fable's event marketing plan and execution, including conferences, customer events, executive dinners, webinars, and community experiences.
  • Lead event planning, logistics, sponsorships, budgets, vendors, and on-site execution.
  • Partner with Sales to develop pre-event outreach, meeting strategies, and account engagement plans for events.
  • Represent Fable at events, engaging prospects, customers, and partners.
  • Lead post-event follow-up, reporting, and campaign optimization to maximize pipeline impact and ROI.

Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in B2B demand generation, integrated marketing, ABM, or field marketing.
  • You love planning creative activations for conferences, trade shows, executive events, or customer programs.
  • Comfortable traveling to conferences and customer events throughout North America and occasionally internationally.
  • Strong curiosity and a problem-solving mindset; you enjoy figuring out how to improve things.
  • Interest in experimentation and learning from data.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally, especially with sales.
  • Comfort working with data and measuring campaign performance.
  • Interest in or experience using AI and automation tools to improve workflows.

Nice to have

  • Experience with marketing automation, CRM, and AI tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier, Clay, Claude, ChatGPT).
  • Exposure to B2B marketing or SaaS environments.
  • Experience supporting campaigns across email, social, or events.

Benefits

What’s in it for you?
At Fable, you’ll join a collaborative and mission-driven environment where you’ll work with people who care deeply about building a more inclusive digital world. We offer benefits such as stock options, career growth opportunities, professional development support, health and dental coverage, and more.

Accessibility accommodations

Fable is an inclusive workplace. If you are facing any accessibility requirements or concerns regarding the hiring process or employment with us, please fill out this form or email us at and include the subject line “Accessibility accommodation for Senior Marketing Campaign Manager job application.”

Pay range

$90,000 – $120,000 on-target earnings, the salary band is designed to reflect the range of skills and experience needed for the position and is subject to change. The final salary is based on relevant skills, experience, and internal equity. This posting reflects an existing vacancy. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools may be used to support part of the recruitment and selection process. However, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring managers.

raw.description:
We are seeking a Mid-Level Full-Stack Engineer to build and enhance customer-facing capabilities across our web application and backend platform. This role is designed for an engineer who has moved beyond entry-level execution and can independently deliver well-defined features, contribute to technical discussions, troubleshoot application issues, and produce reliable, tested code. The engineer will work with senior engineers, Product, UX, QA, and DevOps to turn product requirements into production software. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across the stack but is not yet expected to independently architect the most complex platform capabilities.

Location:LATAM 100% Remote. Working hours are based on the US Central-Pacific Time Zone, with at least 6 working hours of overlap.

About Us:

Abstra is a fast-growing, Nearshore Tech Talent services company, providing top Latin American tech talent to U.S. companies and beyond. Founded by U.S.-bred engineers with over 15 years of experience, Abstra specializes in sourcing skilled professionals across a wide range of technologies to meet our clients’ needs, driving innovation and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain front-end features, backend services, APIs, and data integrations.
  • Implement product requirements and UX designs using established architectural and coding patterns.
  • Build reusable, responsive, and accessible user-interface components.
  • Develop backend business logic, database interactions, application APIs, and background processes.
  • Write clean, understandable, and maintainable code.
  • Create and maintain unit, integration, component, and end-to-end tests.
  • Participate in technical planning, estimation, refinement, and implementation discussions.
  • Identify requirement gaps, technical risks, dependencies, and edge cases during development.
  • Troubleshoot defects and production issues with support from senior engineers when necessary.
  • Participate actively in pull-request reviews and respond constructively to feedback.
  • Maintain technical documentation for the capabilities they build.
  • Work with QA to validate acceptance criteria and improve test coverage.
  • Collaborate with DevOps to resolve deployment, environment, and operational issues.
  • Use logging, monitoring, browser tools, and database queries to diagnose application behavior.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate development, test creation, documentation, and troubleshooting while validating all generated output.
  • Participate in release validation and production support activities.

Required Qualifications

  • Approximately 3 to 6 years of professional software development experience.
  • Professional experience building production web applications.
  • Proficiency with JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • Experience with React or another modern component-based frontend framework.
  • Understanding of component design, state management, API integration, responsive layouts, and frontend testing.
  • Backend development experience using Node.js, Python, Java, C#, or comparable technology.
  • Experience building or consuming REST APIs.
  • Experience working with relational databases and writing SQL queries.
  • Understanding of common data-modeling concepts.
  • Experience with Git, pull requests, code reviews, and team-based development workflows.
  • Experience writing automated units and integration tests.
  • Basic understanding of cloud-hosted applications, deployment pipelines, containers, and application environments.
  • Ability to troubleshoot defects using logs, browser development tools, API clients, and database queries.
  • Understanding of fundamental software design principles and common web-application security concerns.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with AWS or another major cloud provider.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with automated browser testing frameworks.
  • Experience with event-driven systems, background jobs, message queues, or asynchronous processing.
  • Experience integrating third-party applications or services.
  • Experience with video, audio, animation, media, creative tooling, or digital asset management.
  • Experience with AI APIs, prompt-based applications, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Experience working on a multi-tenant SaaS platform.
  • Experience in an Agile or iterative product-development environment.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation paid in USD.
  • 20 days of paid time off (PTO) per year.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career development.
  • Company-provided equipment.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and multicultural work environment.
  • The opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects alongside a talented and supportive team.

Pre-Employment Verification
As part of our standard onboarding process, candidates who successfully complete the interview process and accept an employment offer will be required to complete an employment verification check, and background check. This process will confirm job titles and dates of employment with two previous employers and is a standard requirement for all new employees joining the company.
